name: preview-source-overwritten-after-initial-render
description: The chip appears briefly, then goes dark or empty after a later state transition changes or removes the visible preview source.
misleading_signals: local preview code seems sound in isolation
confirming_evidence: preview_resolved_source_changed transitions from non-null to null
standard_next_capture: Capture attachment state immediately after drop and again after darkening, plus preview_resolved_source_changed events.

name: preview-send-authority-coupling
description: The same field or source is incorrectly used for both chip rendering and outbound send preparation, causing preview and submission behavior to interfere.
misleading_signals: send starts working in one mode but preview regresses elsewhere
confirming_evidence: display source and submission source are not modeled separately
send preparation reads the current preview source instead of original or durable authority
standard_next_capture: Inspect staged attachment fields and verify whether display and send paths are using separate authorities.

name: borrowed-preview-lifecycle
description: The composer displays a preview source owned by another subsystem, such as output lifecycle or drag transport, and that source is later revoked or replaced.
misleading_signals: same source looks valid on the original card
confirming_evidence: blob or transient URLs originate outside composer ownership
later cleanup or output updates coincide with chip failure
standard_next_capture: Record preview source type and ownership, then correlate darkening with replacement, clear, reset, or cleanup events.

name: wrong-media-kind-staged-into-image-lane
description: Audio or video references enter an image-only attachment path and render as empty or nonsensical chips.
misleading_signals: the drag path itself appears functional
the user reports a visual failure that resembles a preview issue
confirming_evidence: payload media kind is audio or video
composer accepted a non-image reference into an image attachment
standard_next_capture: Capture media kind, transfer types, and final staged attachment kind before patching preview logic.

name: local-tests-prove-wrong-branch
description: Targeted tests pass repeatedly, but they validate a local branch or abstraction that the failing production runtime is not actually taking.
symptoms: same bug persists across several coherent fixes
misleading_signals: coverage exists for the touched component
unit tests prove fallback behavior locally
confirming_evidence: runtime payload or event path remains unobserved
standard_next_capture: Pause implementation and capture one failing production runtime packet before further code changes.

name: internal-drag-misclassified-as-local-file
description: An app-owned internal drag carries enough browser-native payload to look like a desktop file drop, so the wrong intake lane wins before structured hints are evaluated.
misleading_signals: drop contains a real-looking image File
local file-drop code works in isolation
confirming_evidence: DataTransfer contains both structured app payloads and synthetic image files
treating structured/internal hints first resolves the incident
the failing lane differs by source surface rather than image bytes
standard_next_capture: Capture transfer types, structured app payload presence, and `files.length`, then verify whether classification trusted `files` before internal/reference hints.
